vocabulary.meaning_en: the work you do to earn money
vocabulary.example: Pete doesn't have a job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the group of people who run a country
vocabulary.example: Many people in Washington work in government.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where sick people get care from doctors and nurses
vocabulary.example: My aunt works at a hospital.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where people study after high school
vocabulary.note_ar: نقول a university وليس an university لأنها تبدأ بصوت /j/
vocabulary.note_en: Say a university (it starts with a /j/ sound).
vocabulary.example: He teaches at a university.

vocabulary.meaning_en: hair that grows on a man's chin and face
vocabulary.example: Pete's beard is really big.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you can do well
vocabulary.example: Everyone has a skill.

vocabulary.meaning_en: instructions for computers; to write those instructions
vocabulary.note_en: Do not confuse code with cold.
vocabulary.example: She can write code for phone apps.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a program on a phone or computer
vocabulary.example: This app helps me learn English.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a group of pages on the internet
vocabulary.example: The school has a new website.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a very large amount of (informal)
vocabulary.example: You can make tons of money writing code.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to control a car, bus or taxi
vocabulary.example: Can you drive a bus?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a car you pay to take you somewhere
vocabulary.example: Let's take a taxi to the airport.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start sleeping
vocabulary.example: I fall asleep when I read in bed.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to help people learn
vocabulary.example: Can you teach? You can be a teacher.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where children learn
vocabulary.example: My brother goes to school by bus.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make food
vocabulary.note_en: A cook is also a person who cooks.
vocabulary.example: Can you cook rice?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a professional cook in a restaurant
vocabulary.example: The chef makes delicious soup.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you buy and eat meals
vocabulary.example: We eat at a restaurant on Fridays.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a website where a person writes regularly about their life or ideas
vocabulary.example: Pete writes about his feelings in his blog.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who reads or watches your posts online
vocabulary.example: She has many followers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not hard
vocabulary.example: This exercise is easy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: difficult; not easy
vocabulary.example: It's really hard to be a race car driver.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a good way
vocabulary.note_ar: good صفة، well ظرف: She is a good writer / She writes well
vocabulary.note_en: Good is an adjective; well is an adverb.
vocabulary.example: Not everyone can write well.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who writes books, articles or stories
vocabulary.example: Pete wants to be a writer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: good things that happen by chance
vocabulary.note_en: Good luck! = I hope things go well.
vocabulary.example: Good luck with your exam!

fine_lines.title: can vs can't
fine_lines.explanation_ar: can = يستطيع، can't (cannot) = لا يستطيع. في النطق الأمريكي can تكون قصيرة وغير منبورة /kən/، و can't تكون قوية وواضحة /kænt/.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Can means you are able; can't (cannot) means you are not able. In American English, can is short and weak /kən/, and can't is strong /kænt/.

fine_lines.title: good vs well
fine_lines.explanation_ar: good صفة تصف الاسم: a good writer. well ظرف يصف الفعل: write well.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Good is an adjective; it describes a noun: a good writer. Well is an adverb; it describes a verb: write well.

fine_lines.title: code vs cold
fine_lines.explanation_ar: Pete خلط بينهما. code = شيفرة الكمبيوتر /koʊd/. cold = بارد /koʊld/ وفيها صوت l.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Pete mixes them up. Code is computer instructions /koʊd/. Cold means not warm /koʊld/, with an l sound.

expressions.meaning_en: Asking if the person you see is someone you know.
expressions.example: Sara? Is that you? I didn't recognize you!

expressions.meaning_en: Your appearance is not the same as before.
expressions.example: You look different. Is that a new haircut?

expressions.meaning_en: Asking why someone is sad or has a problem.

expressions.example: Sorry, I can't hear you. It's very noisy here.

expressions.meaning_en: A kind answer to bad news.
expressions.example: I don't have a job. - I'm sorry to hear that.
That bag is heavy. Let me help.
Can you write code? - Yes, I can.

expressions.meaning_en: I am not able to do any useful thing.
expressions.example: Don't say 'I can't do anything.' Everyone has a skill.

expressions.meaning_en: All people are good at something.
expressions.example: Everyone has a skill. You need to find yours.

expressions.meaning_en: I hope things go well for you.
expressions.example: You have a job interview? Good luck!

expressions.phrase: Excuse me, I have to go.
expressions.example: Excuse me, I have to go. My bus is here.

grammar.title: can / can't for ability
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) نستخدم can + فعل مجرد للتعبير عن القدرة: I can write. 2) النفي: can't أو cannot: I can't cook. 3) لا نضيف s للفعل بعد can حتى مع he/she: She can drive (وليس She can drives). 4) لا نضع to بعد can: can swim وليس can to swim.
grammar.explanation_en: 1) Use can + base verb to talk about ability: I can write. 2) Negative: can't or cannot: I can't cook. 3) No -s after can, even with he/she: She can drive. 4) No to after can: can swim, not can to swim.
examples: We cannot drive a race car.

grammar.title: Questions with can
grammar.explanation_ar: للسؤال نضع can قبل الفاعل: Can you drive? والجواب القصير: Yes, I can. / No, I can't. ومع أداة استفهام: What can you do?
grammar.explanation_en: To ask, put can before the subject: Can you drive? Short answers: Yes, I can. / No, I can't. With a question word: What can you do?
examples: Can you cook? - No, I can't.
Can you help me? - Yes, I can.

grammar.title: You can be a ... (talking about jobs)
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم can be + a/an + وظيفة لنقترح عملًا: You can be a teacher. ونستخدم a قبل الكلمة التي تبدأ بصوت ساكن: a chef, a writer، و an قبل صوت متحرك: an engineer.
grammar.explanation_en: Use can be + a/an + job to suggest work: You can be a teacher. Use a before a consonant sound (a chef, a writer) and an before a vowel sound (an engineer).
examples: You can be a teacher in a school.
You can be a chef in a restaurant.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: She can to drive a bus.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد can نضع الفعل المجرد بدون s وبدون to.
questions.explanation_en: After can, use the base verb: no -s, no to.

questions.question: 'Can you cook?' - 'No, I ___.'
questions.explanation_ar: الجواب القصير بالنفي: No, I can't.
questions.explanation_en: The short negative answer is No, I can't.

questions.question: A professional cook in a restaurant is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A chef is a professional cook.

questions.question: Instructions for making apps and websites are ___.
questions.explanation_ar: code هي البرمجة. cold تعني بارد.
questions.explanation_en: Code is computer instructions; cold means not warm.

questions.question: Not everyone can write ___.
questions.explanation_en: Use the adverb well to describe the verb write.

questions.question: Your friend says, 'I don't have a job.' You say:
questions.explanation_ar: نردّ على الخبر السيئ بـ I'm sorry to hear that.
questions.explanation_en: We answer bad news with I'm sorry to hear that.

questions.question: ___ you write code?
questions.explanation_ar: في السؤال نضع can قبل الفاعل.
questions.explanation_en: In a question, can comes before the subject.

questions.question: 'Writing is easy.' The opposite of easy is:
questions.explanation_en: The opposite of easy is hard.

questions.question: People who read your blog are your ___.
questions.explanation_en: Followers are people who read or watch your posts.

questions.question: You can be ___ teacher in a school.
questions.explanation_ar: teacher تبدأ بصوت ساكن، فنستخدم a.
questions.explanation_en: Teacher starts with a consonant sound, so use a.
